related.title: Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片；Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦改以矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices; Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer centers on matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照v5p TensorCore與v4 MXU張量shape，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以Pod與單作業上限為起點，設計一項能區分「矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片」與「矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare v5p tensorcore with v4 mxu tensor shapes and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from pod and per-job limits and propose an observation distinguishing matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices from matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects, including uncertainty.

practiceEn: Compare v5p tensorcore with wse local cores and sram and redraw inputs and boundaries.
